Amber Cove Shore Excursions

Amber Cove is the cruise port Carnival Corporation built on Maimón Bay, about 12 km (7.5 miles) from downtown Puerto Plata. We pick you up at the port and plan your tour around your ship’s schedule.

We pick you up at the port

  1. Book on WhatsApp or by email and tell us your ship’s name and all-aboard time.
  2. We confirm the exact meeting point at the port on WhatsApp or by email.
  3. We plan the tour around your ship’s schedule and bring you back to the port.
  4. For catamarans and yachts, transport to Sosúa is optional: add it when you book; it’s priced by group size.

Amber Cove questions

Mostly Carnival Corporation brands: Carnival, Princess, Holland America, P&O and other lines in the group. Other cruise lines call occasionally, so check your cruise itinerary. If your ship docks at Taíno Bay instead, we pick you up there too.

About 12 km (7.5 miles), a 15–20 minute drive. It is not walkable: the port sits on Maimón Bay, west of the city. Round-trip transport from the port is included in our other tours; for the catamarans and yachts it’s optional.

About 30–45 minutes by road, depending on traffic. The 27 Charcos de Damajagua (Damajagua Falls) are near Imbert, south of Puerto Plata. We pick you up at the port and bring you back, and the tour includes a buffet lunch.

Yes. You can leave the port during your call and take your tour with a local operator like us. Tell us your ship’s name and all-aboard time: we pick you up at the port and plan the day around your ship’s schedule.

Pools, shops, restaurants, bars and a zip line; some attractions cost extra. To see more of Puerto Plata, our tours start right at the port: waterfalls, the city, the beach or a private boat.

Docking at Amber Cove? Message us your date and your ship’s name.
